whatIs: React Vibe is a collection of React components focused on motion: UI blocks, hero sections, animated backgrounds, text animations and dashboard systems. You copy the code into your project and modify it; it isn't installed as a package. The components that animate use Framer Motion, which you install once.
It's a good fit when you want a landing page or dashboard with an expressive interface and prefer to own the code of each component.
uses: Build a landing page's hero section with animated backgrounds and text.
Add a pricing, FAQ or testimonials block to a product page.
Build a dashboard with cards, tables and charts as a base for a SaaS.
caveats: It's a single-author personal project with few GitHub stars; don't expect the backing of a large library.
The animated components depend on Framer Motion, which adds weight to the bundle.
The dashboards marked PRO are part of the TaskForge template, which is sold separately.
pricingNote: The components are open source under the MIT license; the TaskForge template is sold separately.
idealFor: React landing pages and dashboards with animations, with each component's code in your project.
